title: 连接 ZY Action Platform
description: 填入你本地 ZY Action Platform 实例的 Client Key（config.yaml → workbuddy.client_key）。连接后 WorkBuddy 将通过云端 Hub 转发到你本地实例执行。凭证仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录下，不经过云端。
description_en: Enter the Client Key of your local ZY Action Platform instance (config.yaml -> workbuddy.client_key). WorkBuddy routes requests through the cloud Hub to your local instance. Credentials are stored locally only (~/.workbuddy).
docLabel_en: How to get the Client Key?

fields.label: Client Key
fields.description: 本地 AIP 实例用于向 zyinfo.pro Hub 注册的关联密钥；留空时 AIP 启动会自动生成并写入 config.yaml。
